title: Chapter 7: Leave and Absence
key_sentences: This chapter explains how annual leave, sickness absence and special leave are managed across all branches.
Your entitlement depends on your length of continuous service on 1 April each year.
Part-time entitlement is calculated pro rata to contracted hours.
If you are too unwell to work, telephone your line manager before your shift starts.
A text message or email is not an acceptable way of reporting sickness.
Self-certification covers the first seven calendar days of any absence.
When you return, your manager will hold a short return-to-work meeting with you.
Special leave is granted at the discretion of the Head of Service.
It is intended for situations that annual leave cannot reasonably cover.
Questions about this chapter should be sent to the HR Advice Team.

list_items.text: i. Submit requests through the rota system at least four weeks in advance.
ii. Your line manager will approve or decline the request within five working days, taking into account:
(a) branch staffing levels during the requested period;
(b) requests already approved for colleagues in the same team;
(c) events that require extra cover, such as:
the summer reading challenge;
school holiday activity weeks;
annual stock-taking days.
iii. Requests for more than ten consecutive working days also need the approval of the Branch Manager.

tell your manager about any work that needs urgent attention, for example:
reserved items waiting to be collected;
room bookings you were due to supervise;
agree when you will next be in contact.
